_note: v2-qb = v1-blend probability, then a logit shift of out_points * points_to_logit * status weight against a team whose season pass-attempt leader is reported out (1.0) or doubtful (0.75). points_to_logit is the mean of v1's fitted SP+ and FPI slopes (0.1260, 0.1561 logit per point). out_points is a prior, not a fit: there is no historical injury feed to fit it on. Revisit after ~4 weeks of v2 rows; any change is a new model_version (v2.1-qb), never an edit here.
